headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 24, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a major upset in the Bronx, defeating the New York Yankees 5-3. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs. The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Addison Barger, Patrick Corbin, and Jonatan Clase of the Toronto Blue Jays, who have been placed on the 60-day, 15-day, and 10-day injured lists, respectively. Samuel Basallo of the Baltimore Orioles has also been placed on the 10-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation. J.T. Ginn of the Athletics, Stephen Kolek of the Kansas City Royals, and Drey Jameson of the Arizona Diamondbacks have been placed on the 15-day injured list.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable deals taking place. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for future considerations. The Houston Astros traded Max Martin to the Kansas City Royals for Nate Pearson, while the Los Angeles Dodgers acquired Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Chicago Cubs also acquired Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Upset in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates defeated the New York Yankees 5-3, handing the Yankees their first loss of the series. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took a 2-0 lead in the game, ultimately securing a win over the Pittsburgh Pirates.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Beavers leading the offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs. Kyle Bradish earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves edged out the San Diego Padres 6-5 in a closely contested game. Impact players on both sides included Luis Rengifo, Manny Machado, Ty France, Drake Baldwin, Ozzie Albies, Michael Harris II, and Dominic Smith.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Guardians 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians in their recent matchup. Steven Kwan and Patrick Bailey were notable contributors for their respective teams, while Gavin Williams stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Addison Barger Placed on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Marinaccio in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres. The deal was made for future considerations.
